## 1. Learning objectives

- Measure queries (.timer) and read EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN (SCAN vs SEARCH)
- Create single-column, multi-column/covering and partial indexes for a given query
- Explain B-tree indexes and their space/write-time trade-offs; reclaim space with VACUUM
- Use BEGIN / COMMIT / ROLLBACK; explain ACID, race conditions and SQLite locks

## 6. Common mistakes

- **C4.1**: optimizing without measuring
- **C4.2**: indexing a column the query doesn't filter on; forgetting PKs already have one
- **C4.3**: wrong column order (filter column must come first)
- **C4.4**: indexing every column "just in case"
- **C4.5**: expecting it to help queries outside its condition
- **C4.6**: expecting DROP/DELETE alone to shrink the file
- **C4.7**: ROLLBACK outside a transaction; forgetting to COMMIT
- **C4.8**: checking a balance outside the transaction that spends it
- **C4.9**: holding an exclusive lock longer than needed
